title: ComplianceMapper: A Tool That Maps Model Cards to EU AI Act Requirements

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible with gap: reducing compliance burden for smaller labs is useful but the chain from a gap-report tool to actual safety improvement requires adoption and action by labs.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Intermediate: parsing Annex IV into a checklist and matching model card sections requires structured text processing, manageable for CS students with guidance but not trivial.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Sustained effort: building a structured checklist from legal text, parsing model cards (PDF and markdown), and producing gap reports requires consistent work across multiple components.

novelty.reasoning: Multiple tools and frameworks already map model cards to EU AI Act requirements. The OECD Model Card Regulatory Check, Compliance Cards, and AI Cards all directly address this problem. The specific Annex IV mapping angle is covered by existing compliance matrices.

evidence: OECD.AI 'Model Card Regulatory Check' tool already automates checking model card information against EU AI Act Article 13 requirements
Compliance Cards (arXiv:2406.14758, 2024) specifically evolves model cards into EU AI Act compliance artifacts with automated mapping
AI Cards framework (arXiv:2406.18211, 2024) provides machine-readable AI documentation inspired by the EU AI Act
IAPP EU AI Act Compliance Matrix already provides structured mapping of Act requirements
The EU AI Act Compliance Checker at artificialintelligenceact.eu provides an existing assessment tool
